description.text: The first Match Battle set. Each Happy Meal box held a four-card pack with one holo card, an instruction sheet, a coin, a spinner and a card box: players flip the coin and spin the spinner to battle with the numbers on their cards, and the last Trainer with a Pokémon in play wins. Pokémon announced it on 16 August 2022, running through mid-September. Six of the 15 cards are holo: Rowlet, Gossifleur, Growlithe, Victini, Pikachu and Smeargle.
